strapiBlog.title: Property of the Week: Coastline Beach Residences at Siniya Island
strapiBlog.short_description: Coastline Beach Residences, an off-plan project by Sobha Realty, promises a lifestyle defined by luxury and tranquility.

data.text:
Coastline Beach Residences, an off-plan project by Sobha Realty, promises a lifestyle defined by luxury and tranquility. Nestled on Siniya Island in Umm Al Quwain, this exceptional development offers a range of elegantly designed apartments and duplexes. With a stunning beachfront location and unparalleled amenities, it epitomizes beachside living at its finest.

Discover the Charm of Coastline Beach Residences at Siniya Island

Location

Situated on the picturesque Siniya Island in Umm Al Quwain, the Coastline Beach Residences project boasts an exclusive location that combines serene coastal beauty with strategic accessibility. The development is conveniently located near Al Ittihad Road (E11), providing seamless connectivity to other emirates of the UAE, including Dubai and Sharjah. 
The pristine surroundings and proximity to natural landscapes enhance the appeal of this sought-after address.

Properties

Coastline Beach Residences presents a diverse selection of homes to cater to various lifestyle needs. The development offers exquisite 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments, along with 2 and 3-bedroom duplexes, each designed with contemporary architectural excellence. 

Prices for these luxurious residences start from AED 1.21M, making them an attractive choice for discerning buyers. 
Featuring floor-to-ceiling windows, the interiors are bathed in natural light, highlighting breathtaking views of the sea and the lush surroundings of Siniya Island. 

Spacious layouts and premium finishes further enhance the sophistication and comfort of every home, offering a truly elevated living experience.

Amenities

The Coastline Beach Residences amenities are thoughtfully curated to deliver an unmatched lifestyle experience. Residents can indulge in a range of recreational and leisure facilities that cater to all ages. The project’s standout Coastline Beach Residences features include:

  • Infinity Swimming Pool - offering breathtaking views and a serene escape for relaxation.
  • Children's Play Areas - designed for safety and fun, ensuring younger residents are always entertained.
  • Sky Garden - providing a tranquil space to enjoy panoramic vistas and unwind amidst nature.
  • Landscaped Parks - perfect for leisurely strolls and outdoor gatherings.
  • 18-hole Golf Course - ideal for enthusiasts seeking a world-class golfing experience.
  • Lagoon Beach - allowing residents to enjoy beachside tranquility just steps from their homes.
  • Adventure Watersports - including kite surfing and paddleboarding, for those seeking thrilling activities by the water.

These exceptional amenities make Coastline Beach Residences a destination where luxury living meets an active and vibrant lifestyle.
